notes: The current native slice proves deterministic region-boundary validation only. It intentionally does not claim Unicode decoding, marker search, Markdown parsing, or filesystem publication.

reproducer.attemptedProgram: mncs 0.18; module mncs.doc.region; classify a bounded generated-region envelope
reproducer.expected: A reusable document layer should provide source-preserving spans and deterministic replacement boundaries while leaving filesystem publication at the host boundary.

requiredBehavior: Provide bounded source views, exact byte/scalar spans, lossless region replacement, and deterministic malformed-region diagnostics. Unicode-aware parsing and Markdown structural nodes are subsequent document slices, not implied by this record.
summary: The family documentation projector is a real text-transform workload, but its host implementation still performs marker search, source slicing, Markdown policy, and publication. Profile 0.18 can express the first bounded typed region decision; the reusable document/text surface remains open and is kept separate from Commons' dynamic registry projection pressure.
title: Source-preserving document regions need a reusable native text surface
